nodes.title: 14.4.3. Main’s 14.4.2 release replay on c5a55681, r2 t3 (an example asked for, then two don’t-knows): the worked part handed the total back to the child. The Director’s shape already said show (fe59b5f1, reached on that turn). The reply guard’s hand-back check (handsBack: a question or a batao verb) read the showing turn as "flat", and its rewrite asked the sum. Now a worked part shown to a stuck child carries move.stuck. brain/say.js needs no hand-back there, and a sentence that asks the child to compute (a question or an instruction to them, with a working-out cue) is guard "quiz": rewritten, then those sentences dropped in code. Never on a safeguard turn: only worked_example moves carry stuck. TEST, read-only: 324 worked_example teacher lines, 82 hand the child a sum. Of the 5 that follow a don’t-know (code read of the child line), 3 hand the child a sum. Tests: tests/r1443-stuck-shown.test.mjs (4, fail on c4b6341f).
